relevant_laws.quote: Upon a highway designated and signposted for one-way traffic a vehicle shall be driven only in the direction designated.

activation_conditions: the highway is designated and signposted for one-way traffic
the subject is driven on it
residue: the rule binds only where the one-way designation is signposted: an unsigned one-way map attribute is not enough
reason.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: judged at every instant on the one-way highway

reason.title: One-way highway (1)
